## Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Bugfix (change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ Feature (change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (e.g. a URL users rely on, or a changed API contract)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally (the same gates CI runs).
- [ ] I added/updated unit and e2e tests where applicable.
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard-accessible and pass the e2e accessibility checks.
- [ ] I updated the documentation where applicable.
